name: pdf-to-xrechnung
description: PDF invoice -> LLM extraction -> deterministic validation -> XRechnung (EN 16931)
author: Serhii Bublyk

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w apps/api && API_ORIGIN=${API_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000} npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/contracts && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w packages/contracts && npm run lint:fix -w apps/api && npm run lint:fix -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/contracts && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:repo-rules && npm run test -w packages/contracts && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
